title: Update of the First NDC of Mozambique (UNFCCC4)
temporal_coverage: Historical climate 1960-2005; extreme events 1980-2019; projections 2046-2065 and 2080-2100; NDC actions mainly 2020-2025
methodology: National synthesis; historical observations from 32 synoptic stations; seven GCMs; INGD/DeSInventar event data
limitations: Projection excerpt does not identify an emissions/RCP scenario; some underlying studies date from 2009; event records are not attribution studies.

title: Mozambique's National Adaptation Plan (UNFCCC5)
temporal_coverage: Current planning framework drawing on historical evidence and forward adaptation needs
methodology: Extensive consultation; sector/thematic adaptation actions; institutional and capacity assessment; theory of change
limitations: Government planning document, not an independent evaluation; several vulnerability datasets acknowledged as incomplete.

title: Mozambique Country Climate and Development Report (CCDR) (World Bank6)
methodology: Climate-development modelling and economic diagnostic; only publication-page findings used here
limitations: Linked full PDF exceeded crawler access limit; exact claims retained only where the verified publication page provides them.

title: Localised Climate-Related Security Risk Assessment: Mozambique Case Study (GPPAC7)
organization: Global Partnership for the Prevention of Armed Conflict (GPPAC)
methodology: Five focus groups; multistakeholder dialogues; questionnaire to 110 stakeholders; local officials, traditional leaders, communities, climate experts and peacebuilders
limitations: Local perceptions and qualitative synthesis; cannot be generalized nationally; authors explicitly state immediate impact of the assessment was difficult to establish.

title: Conflict Analysis of Cabo Delgado Province in Mozambique
geographic_coverage: Ancuabe, Chiure, Mecufi and Pemba, Cabo Delgado
temporal_coverage: Conflict since 2017; primary study contemporary to report
methodology: Desk review, key-informant interviews, quantitative survey, n=172
limitations: Not a climate study; intentionally used to retain independent conflict drivers and local peace capacities. Sample locations are not representative of all Cabo Delgado or Mozambique. Publisher passage access failed during the 26 October 2026 review; no snippet was used as verification.

title: Mozambique: IPC Acute Food Insecurity Snapshot, Oct 2025-Mar 2026 (IPCinfo8)
temporal_coverage: Oct 2025-Mar 2026, with linked analyses extending to Sep 2026
methodology: Combination of post-shock and post-harvest IPC analyses
limitations: Not designed to isolate causal effects of climate versus conflict/markets; geographic coverage differs between component analyses.

title: Mozambique Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2, February 2026 (UNICEF9)
methodology: Operational monitoring drawing on displacement assessments and government/partner reporting
limitations: Humanitarian operational report rather than independent evaluation; programme outputs should not be read as demonstrated long-term outcomes.

title: Humanitarian Action for Children - Mozambique Appeal 2026 (UNICEF10)
methodology: Humanitarian needs synthesis plus planned targets and programme strategy
limitations: Appeal document; targets and intended mechanisms are not evidence of effectiveness.

title: Inter-Agency Humanitarian Evaluation of the Response to Cyclone Idai in Mozambique (World Food Programme11)
methodology: Independent collective-response evaluation; representative survey of affected population plus evaluative evidence
limitations: Publication page fully accessible; linked full evaluation download was not retrievable through the crawler, so only verified publication-page findings are used.

title: Seeds, Cash, and Preparedness: FAO's Anticipatory Actions (FAOHome12)
geographic_coverage: Machanga, Sofala; Maganja da Costa, Zambézia
methodology: FAO administrative/programme reporting on anticipatory action
limitations: Self-reported implementation/output evidence; no independent counterfactual or outcome evaluation.

title: Climate Change Adaptation Action and Mainstreaming in Mozambique - Final Evaluation (UNDP IEO Evaluation Resource Center13)
methodology: Document/financial review, Maputo mission, stakeholder interviews, primary/secondary evidence
limitations: Old relative to current institutional conditions; evaluator found weak monitoring and inability to cleanly attribute observed mainstreaming results to the project.

title: Leaving No One Behind at Local Level: Cabo Delgado Province Report
organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Mozambique; Government of Mozambique
temporal_coverage: Local fieldwork May–June 2023; report published September 2025; climate-shock findings include Cyclone Kenneth (2019) and prior analysis through 2021.
methodology: Review of provincial/district statistics and documents; interviews and survey involving 148 people in Cabo Delgado.
limitations: District selection considered poverty, security and accessibility; findings are not representative of the whole province. Some climate-conflict statements summarize cited prior reports.

title: Mozambique Humanitarian Situation Report No. 12 (End of Year), 31 December 2025
temporal_coverage: Situation and UNICEF response reporting for January–December 2025; report published 9 February 2026.
methodology: UNICEF operational reporting drawing on government, partner, displacement and service-delivery data.
limitations: Operational report, not an independent impact evaluation; needs and partner-reported outputs may be incomplete. Historical 2025 results are not current 2026 conditions.

title: United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework Evaluation: Mozambique (2025), Final Report
organization: United Nations Sustainable Development Group; independent evaluation team
temporal_coverage: Evaluation of 2022–2026 Cooperation Framework; findings mainly cover 2022–2025; field visits and interviews in August–September 2025.
methodology: Independent evaluation using document review, surveys, interviews, focus groups and site visits, with triangulation.
limitations: Fieldwork focused on Maputo, Gaza and Niassa and synthesized some parallel agency evaluations; time, selection, recall and institutional biases remain possible.

title: Comunidades de Cabo Delgado Validam Planos de Acção Espacial
organization: United Nations in Mozambique; Cabo Delgado Provincial Government; UN-Habitat and partners
temporal_coverage: Community planning release dated 26 August 2026; plans and near-term actions described at publication.
methodology: Official UN release describing a participatory territorial-planning process and selected communities.
limitations: Press release reports planned measures and stated tension risks, not an evaluation of implementation or outcomes.

title: Dngrh Reúne Sectores-chave para fazer Balanço da época Chuvosa 2025/2026
organization: Mozambique Ministry of Public Works, Housing and Water Resources (MOPHRH), National Directorate of Water Resources Management
geographic_coverage: Rovuma, Messalo, Montepuez and Megaruma basins
Zambeze, Búzi, Save, Limpopo, Incomáti and Umbelúzi basins
temporal_coverage: Government review of the 2025–2026 rainy and cyclone season; review meeting held 14–15 May 2026; page date not stated.
methodology: Ministry account of a national seasonal review convened by the National Directorate of Water Resources Management.
limitations: Brief official meeting report; no district-level population denominator or climate-change attribution is supplied.

title: Presidente do INGD destaca a importância da antecipação durante o balanço da época chuvosa 2025/2026 em Moçambique
organization: National Institute for Disaster Risk Management and Reduction (INGD), Mozambique
temporal_coverage: INGD review of the 2025–2026 rainy and cyclone season; anticipatory actions reported for December 2025–March 2026; page published 13 August 2026.
methodology: Official summary by the INGD president of seasonal review findings and anticipatory-action results presented to government and partners.
limitations: Aggregated agency-reported results; the release does not disaggregate evacuations or warning reach by named district or establish a counterfactual.
